networks.name: hook_lab
networks.description: Give me a topic. My writer drafts hooks and titles in different styles, my critic scores them and picks a winner.
sample_queries: Test hooks for a YouTube video about why most people quit learning a language in month two.
Give me Chinese hooks for an X post about cheap weekend trips around Chengdu.
Make hook 3 shorter and score it again.
Send the winning hook to Creator Agent Studio for a script outline and a thread.
Tell me which hook got the most views last week.

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions, plus the partner sites in allowed_peers, which this site calls only after the visitor agrees on a card.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
